reason: The plugin is primarily a browser-game planning and execution assistant for DeepSeek Harness: the README and package metadata show it ships one skill that guides idea-to-spec conversion and prototype generation for browser games. Its documented scope is intentionally limited to local planning/building support, with no deployment, publishing, or external API execution in this version.

summaries.zh: 该插件是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技能包，帮助用户将模糊的浏览器游戏创意整理为紧凑游戏方案，并在本地生成可玩的原型草稿。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness skill package that helps turn vague browser-game ideas into a compact game specification and generates a local playable prototype draft.

capabilities: Convert rough browser-game ideas into a structured game SPEC
Generate or improve a small playable browser-game prototype
Operate as a DeepSeek Harness skill through a single bundled skill interface
Run local planning/building flow without managing deployment or publishing

reasons.code: README states the bundle provides the `opengame-browser-game-builder` Skill and describes transforming ideas into a compact game SPEC and prototype.
Package metadata defines a DeepSeek Harness bundle via `dsh.bundle.patch` and includes plugin packaging files.
README explicitly says this version is a local Skill bundle and does not sign in, call OpenGame APIs, publish games, or deploy a runtime.
